The proposed Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, has been filed by the insurer against the Award dated 01.04.2024, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal /
IInd Additional District Judge, Haldwani, District Nainital in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.90 of 2022, by which the learned Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.76,35,255/- as a compensation along with interest from the date of the petition till its actual payment.
2.

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Pulak Agarwal, learned counsel for the appellant.
3. Mr. Pulak Agarwal, Advocate, contended that the income of the deceased has been wrongly assessed and no income tax has been deducted while assessing the income.
Issue notice to the respondent no.1, respondent no.3 to respondent no.5.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Heard on the Stay Application (IA No.1 of 2024).

8. Mr. Pulak Agarwal, Advocate has sought four weeks' time from today to deposit Rs.50,00,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Lakh) before the concerned Tribunal.
9. Subject to depositing of Rs.50,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Lakh), as prayed, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 01.04.2024, are stayed till further order.
10. The Stay Application (IA No.1 of 2024) is disposed of accordingly.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 13.06.2024 Shiv/
